numeric_conflict_reference_definition: Union of numbers in author gold caption and all detected figure elements (axes, labels, legends): fig['caption'] + ' ' + ' '.join(e.get('text', '') for e in fig.get('elements', []))

per_figure_difference_grounded_minus_ima.methodology_note: The grounded condition is provided with OCR-extracted figure text which also contributes to the reference vocabulary defining non-conflict. Wording claiming that grounded evidence 'suppresses hallucinations' is replaced by the empirical difference of -0.0275 (95% CI [-0.0933, +0.0392]), which spans zero and is not statistically significant.

scq_metric_status.note: Per Non-Negotiable Rules 1 & 3: SCQ metric remains unvalidated as no in-house human validation study was conducted.
